correctness.rationale: For a unit path the third eigenvalue Λ=2−2cos(2pi/n) is the rank-one interlacing upper ceiling for a single nonnegative chord Laplacian. An edge vector b not orthogonal to the second nonconstant cosine mode u_2 admits a mean-zero combination of u_1,u_2 killed by b with Rayleigh quotient strictly <Λ (using b·u_1≠0), so saturation forces i+j=n−1. Reversal then separates the unchanged even sector (least positive Λ) and odd sector A=(L−ΛI)|odd with one strictly negative eigenvalue. Schur inertia gives A+wbb^T PSD iff 1+w b^TA^{-1}b<=0. The explicitly checked piecewise sine/cosine Green solution has b^TA^{-1}b=−sin((2i+1)2pi/n)/sin(2pi/n); hence the exact strict-positive sine and sharp w threshold, including equality. Maximizing sine over admissible odd r=2i+1 yields delta_n nearest-odd formula, n4 endpoint, w1 optimizer set and asymptotic 2pi/n+O(n^-3). Independently built each augmented path Laplacian and checked all chord choices for n4..14 by dense eigenvalues; no finite SVD can establish the all-n theorem.

These are motivated design quantities, not arbitrary numerology.
